name: Eutolmius Scholasticus of Alexandria
bio: Eutolmius Scholasticus of Alexandria is one of the epigrammatists whose short poems were gathered in the Greek Anthology. Paton's index of authors dates the poet to 5th century AD. Paton's index lists the poet among the writers of the Cycle of Agathias, compiled in the sixth century AD.
This archive carries the 1 epigram ascribed to the poet in the first volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Books I–VI) (Book VI: 86).

poems.title: Book VI, 86: In allusion to the above
poems.author: Eutolmius Scholasticus of Alexandria
poems.text: Rufus Gettius, son of Memmias, suspended here to Athene his greaves, breastplate, shield, helmet and spear. tine forces for the most part consisted. Timo is a blunder for the name of some god. The officer was of rather high rank, a primipilarius.
